label: Early-position digit 0 (or 2) input during the original phase
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, never at t=0, the delimiter, or the copy phase. It fires mostly when the input token is the digit 0 (60% of activation mass, 16x lift), then 2 (23%) and 1 (12%), with weak tails on h and z. It is concentrated at positions t=1..4 and fades by t=6-7. The first occurrence of the token carries 93% of the mass. The strongest activations are 0 at position 3-4 after letter prefixes such as p/b/s. Only about a quarter to a half of matching steps are active, and no simple feature of the earlier tokens (first token, previous token, digits seen) explains which ones; mass recall of the predicate is about 0.81. It does not fire on letters other than h/z, or on 3.
